# Test 05: Multi-level sealed hierarchy
# Shape is sealed with Circle and Polygon;
# Polygon is sealed with Square and Triangle.
# Covering Circle + Square + Triangle should be exhaustive for Shape.
# Expected: exhaustive

TYPES
sealed Shape Circle Polygon
record Circle double:radius parent:Shape
sealed Polygon Square Triangle
record Square double:side parent:Polygon
final Triangle parent:Polygon

SWITCHES
switch s1 Shape
type Circle
type Square
type Triangle
end
